scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix server run lint:fix && npm --prefix client run lint:fix && npm run format
scripts.format: npm --prefix server run format && npm --prefix client run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix server run format:check && npm --prefix client run format:check
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix client install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.test: concurrently "npm --prefix server run test:run" "npm --prefix client run test:run"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently "npm --prefix server run test:coverage" "npm --prefix client run test:coverage"
